# QoF v1.5.0's "Well Equipped" Update > [!NOTE] > A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel. Requires **BetaAPIs** enabled under Experiments. ## Pack Info Full changelog: [v1.5.0](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/commits/v1.5.0) or [compare](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) Releases: [v1.5.0](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases/tag/v1.5.0) LICENSE: [MIT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitji/QoF/refs/heads/behavior_packs/LICENSE)\ Release Date: [Apr/19/2026 (02:54:19)](https://time.is/Unix_time_converter/1776567259) Base Game Version: [26.12](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/44732288765837-Minecraft-Bedrock-Edition-26-12-Hotfix-Changelog)\ Dependency: [2.7.0@beta](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@minecraft/server/v/2.7.0-beta.1.26.10-stable) # Table of Contents - [QoF v1.5.0's Changelog](#qof-v150s-changelog) - [Pack Info](#pack-info) - [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents) - [Changelog](#changelog) - [Debug](#debug) - [(New) Unwaxed Sign](#new-unwaxed-sign) - [(New) Cauldron+](#new-cauldron) - [Dynamic Light](#dynamic-light) - [Carried Container](#carried-container) - [Offhand](#offhand) - [Recipes+](#recipes) - [Crafting](#crafting) - [Stone Cutter](#stone-cutter) - [Bug Fixes](#bug-fixes) - [License](#license) - [Credits](#credits) ## Changelog - A full wiki is now available on GitHub. You can explore it here: [https://github.com/aitji/QoF/wiki](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/wiki) - The project has been rewritten in TypeScript for better structure and maintainability - Pre-releases will no longer be published to CurseForge or MCPEDL due to the 2-week update cycle limitation. You can still find the latest pre-releases on GitHub: [https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases) - The `scripts` folder has been restructured to make future module development easier - Frequently accessed data is now cached in memory instead of being fetched repeatedly from the API, improving performance - The build system has been updated. Ignore rules are no longer hardcoded in YAML files and are now handled via `/build.gitignore` - All preview and showcase images have been compressed, reducing total size from `206.3MB` to `103.2MB` - The heartbeat checker (mcfunction-based) may impact performance. It can now be disabled in the in-game settings panel. It is enabled by default as it helps non-power users ### Debug Debug mode is intended for developers who want to explore or test internal systems. It now includes new tools: - `/dyp` dynamic property tools (list, list with values, bulk actions) - `/cache` retrieve cached data from player or world - `/components` dump block or item component lists (names only) - `/dampening` obtain the light dampening block with value > These tools are only available when DEBUG is set to `true`. This can be toggled in the in-game settings panel ### (New) Unwaxed Sign Signs can now be unwaxed using an axe. Durability is consumed by default, but this can be configured in the in-game settings panel ### (New) Cauldron+ Cauldrons in Bedrock Edition now have expanded functionality with QoF (Quality of Feature) | Item | Dye | Clean | | --------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------- | | Carpet | `#` Carpet | White Carpet | | Wool | `#` Wool | White Wool | | Concrete | `#` Concrete | White Concrete | | Concrete Powder | `#` Concrete Powder | White Concrete Powder | | Glass | `#` Stained Glass | Glass | | Glass Pane | `#` Stained Glass Pane | Glass Pane | | Hardened Clay | `#` Terracotta | Hardened Clay | | `#` Terracotta | `#` Terracotta | Hardened Clay | | `#` Glazed Terracotta | `#` Glazed Terracotta | White Glazed Terracotta | > Note > `#` represents any color\ > Shulkers, banners, and bundles are not supported due to NBT limitations ### Dynamic Light - Magma Cubes now emit light at level `9` > Light level is still affected by reduction settings ### Carried Container - Item names shown in lore now use client-side localization > Example change: > `minecraft:trapped_chest` -> `tile.trapped_chest.name` ### Offhand - `Spear` has been added to the always-usable list - Players can now place blocks directly from the offhand - Dev note: sound implementation is not yet complete due to technical limitations - `Bamboo`, `Torch`, and `Slabs` are handled differently from standard blocks - New replaceable blocks added: `Snow Layer`, `Fire`, `Soul Fire`, `Crimson Roots`, `Warped Roots`, `Seagrass`, `Sculk Vein`, and all types of `Dry Grass` > bug ref > > Fixed an issue where placing a torch from the offhand would break adjacent blocks when placed on the side (introduced in dev-release v1.4.1) ### Recipes+ ### Crafting - The vanilla `minecraft:paper` recipe can now be crafted directly in the inventory | Crafting recipe | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | ![paper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitji/QoF/refs/heads/sources/recipes/shapeless/paper.png) | - ### Dynamic Light - Dynamic lights now process using a round-robin batch system for better overall performance - Dynamic lights are no longer saved in dynamic properties. All lights now exist only in memory > All dynamic lights created before this update that were stored in dynamic properties will be migrated automatically ### Harvest - Auto-replant now supports `Cocoa Bean`. Players can harvest it using an axe - Players can place seeds in their offhand, and the system will prioritize seeds from the offhand when replanting! ### Composter+ - Added `Golden Dandelion` to the custom compostable item list ### Offhand - Players can now plant all seed types from their offhand - `Jukebox` now requires the player to sneak when placing a torch - The offhand system now includes a larger list of items that cannot be used in the offhand if they are held in the main hand > bug ref > > While the player is eating food in the main hand, they cannot place a torch from the offhand ### Recipe+ - Removed the recipes that allow transfer between stone and quartz-related stone in the stone cutter - Created the subcategories of the furnace recipe folder - Added dye recipes to solve the hardly obtainable color, e.g. green, brown dye
- Flowers can increase in the inventory for saving time usage
**alt-text**: Combining `Red Tulip` and `Bone Meal` to `x4 Red Tulips` in the _Inventory_ ### Bug Fixes - While the player is eating food in the main hand, they cannot place a torch from the offhand # Pre-release Changelogs (v1.3.x) All updates from pre-releases are included in the v1.4.0 release.

**alt-text**: Smelting `red sand` to glass in _blast furnace_ #### 2. `Hanging Roots & Dirt` to `Rooted Dirt` (`Craft`)
**alt-text**: Combining Hanging Roots with Dirt to Rooted Dirt in _inventory_ #### 3. `Chorus Fruit` to `Popped Chorus Fruit` (`Smoker`, `Campfire`)
**alt-text**: Roasting `Chorus Fruit` to `Popped Chorus Fruit` in _Campfire_ `(also work with Smoker)` ### Bug Fixes - Players in `Creative` gamemode can no longer use hoes for auto-harvest - Torches no longer be placed on `qof:light_block` - Fixed `large_fern` being incorrectly named `tall_fern` - `qof_light_block` no longer produces stone sounds when pushed by a piston

# QoF v1.3.1's Changelog

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel. Requires **BetaAPIs** enabled under Experiments.

## Pack Info

Full changelog: [v1.3.1](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/commits/v1.3.1) or [compare](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) Releases: [v1.3.1](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases/tag/v1.3.1) LICENSE: [MIT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitji/QoF/refs/heads/behavior_packs/LICENSE)\
Release Date: [Mar/28/2026 (09:51:30)](https://time.is/Unix_time_converter/1774691490)

Base Game Version: [26.10 Tiny-Takeover](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/44418129038733-Minecraft-Bedrock-Edition-26-10-Tiny-Takeover)\
Dependency: [2.7.0@beta](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@minecraft/server/v/2.7.0-beta.1.26.10-stable)

# Table of Contents

- [QoF v1.3.1's Changelog](#qof-v131s-changelog)
  - [Pack Info](#pack-info)
- [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents)
  - [Changelogs](#changelogs)
    - [Carried Container](#carried-container)
    - [Dynamic Light](#dynamic-light)
    - [Bug Fixes](#bug-fixes)
- [License](#license)
- [Credits](#credits)

## Changelogs

- `javascript` and `json` files are now automatically minified before release to reduce file size
- `_notes.md` added to the root directory of both `behavior_packs` and `resource_packs`
- Added more images and GIFs to `README.md`
- Updated `banner` and `pack_icon` by @pickerth-12

### Carried Container

- Players can no longer carry `lit_*` blocks `(e.g. Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker)`

### Dynamic Light

- `LIGHT_REDUCE_LINEAR` default value increased to `2` (previously `1`) so light decays faster
- Some items that previously could not emit light underwater now check the player head position when touching water and the feet position while swimming
- Dynamic Light files have been split into:
  - `light.js` for the main dynamic light logic
  - `light_patcher.js` for bug fixes and workarounds for Minecraft limitations

> ref bug
>
> - Fixed `carrots` and `potatoes` not being placeable on farmland when a dynamic light source is nearby
> - Fixed dynamic light turning `grass path` into `dirt` when near a `grass path`
> - Fixed incorrect `LIGHT_REDUCE_LINEAR` logic in `_store.js`

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed `carrots` and `potatoes` not being placeable on farmland when a dynamic light source is nearby
- Fixed dynamic light turning `grass path` into `dirt` when near a `grass path`
- Fixed incorrect `LIGHT_REDUCE_LINEAR` logic in `_store.js`

# License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

- @pickerth-12 design, json & molang

# QoF v1.1.1's Changelog

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel. Requires **BetaAPIs** enabled under Experiments.

## Pack Info

Full changelog: [v1.1.1](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/commits/v1.1.1) or [compare](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) Releases: [v1.1.1](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/releases/tag/v1.1.1) LICENSE: [MIT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aitji/QoF/refs/heads/behavior_packs/LICENSE)\
Release Date: [Mar/17/2026 (17:15:16)](https://time.is/Unix_time_converter/1773767716)

Base Game Version: [26.3](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/43861703542925-Minecraft-Bedrock-Edition-26-3-Changelog)\
Dependency: [2.5.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@minecraft/server/v/2.5.0)

# Table of Contents

- [QoF v1.1.1's Changelog](#qof-v111s-changelog)
  - [Pack Info](#pack-info)
- [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents)

    - [Configs Update!](#configs-update)
    - [Carrying Container](#carrying-container)
    - [Anvil Repairing](#anvil-repairing)
    - [Composter+](#composter)
    - [Dynamic Light](#dynamic-light)
    - [Recipe+](#recipe)
- [License](#license)
- [Credits](#credits)

## Changelogs

### Configs Update!

- `scripts/_config.js` now heavily uses `Object.freeze(...)`

### Carrying Container

- Add `qof:chest` entity to temporarily store container
- Add `scripts/addon/chest.js` to allow players to pick up _any container_

### Anvil Repairing

- Anvil now has `permCache` to cache block states for reuse.
- Anvil has more edge case handling (e.g. roll back when item removal failed)
  > _TL;DR_ optimization & edge case

### Composter+

- Vanilla Composter now supports hoppers and can compost more items from our list while staying vanilla-friendly.
- Composter code has been further optimized

### Dynamic Light

- Armor Stands holding items are marked as not working [api limitation](https://github.com/aitji/QoF/blob/behavior_packs/README.md?plain=1#L435)
  > `README.md` is not updated in this version, Here is a phrase
  > "... - `Limitations` Armor Stands do not support the equippable component in the current API. Items held by armor Stands do not emit dynamic light only item frames are supported for static placed sources. ..."

behavior_packs changes:

- Capitalized names
- Added "Slab" and proper block names
- Fixed plural blocks like "Bricks", "Tiles", "Planks"
- Slight wording improvement in the description

### Recipe+

Double slabs can be crafted back into their corresponding blocks by stacking two slabs on top of each other.
